pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatment using sodium hydroxide (NaOH) at 100°C for 10 minutes, involving presoaking, heating, cooling, centrifugation, and freeze-drying.
Liquid hot water (LHW) pretreatment using distilled water at elevated temperature and pressure.
Biological pretreatment using aerobic sludge at 37°C and 90 rpm for 10 days.
Ultrasonic pretreatment using sound waves at 40 kHz for 30 minutes.
